title: Opening Prayer to the Tao
original_text: 道生一，一生二，二生三，三生萬物。
translated_text: The Tao gives birth to One. One gives birth to Two. Two gives birth to Three. Three gives birth to all things.
transliteration: Dào shēng yī, yī shēng èr, èr shēng sān, sān shēng wàn wù.

title: Prayer for Harmony
original_text: 人法地，地法天，天法道，道法自然。
translated_text: Man follows Earth. Earth follows Heaven. Heaven follows the Tao. The Tao follows its own nature.
transliteration: Rén fǎ dì, dì fǎ tiān, tiān fǎ dào, dào fǎ zì rán.

title: Morning Meditation
original_text: 致虛極，守靜篤。萬物並作，吾以觀復。
translated_text: Attain the utmost emptiness. Hold firmly to stillness. The ten thousand things rise and fall, while I watch their return.
transliteration: Zhì xū jí, shǒu jìng dǔ. Wàn wù bìng zuò, wú yǐ guān fù.

title: Evening Reflection
original_text: 知其雄，守其雌，為天下谿。
translated_text: Know the strong, but keep to the lowly. Be the stream of the world.
transliteration: Zhī qí xióng, shǒu qí cí, wéi tiān xià xī.

title: Prayer for Longevity
original_text: 深根固柢，長生久視之道。
translated_text: Deepen the root and firm the foundation — this is the way of long life and lasting vision.
transliteration: Shēn gēn gù dǐ, cháng shēng jiǔ shì zhī dào.

title: Prayer of Contentment
original_text: 知足不辱，知止不殆，可以長久。
translated_text: Know contentment and you will not suffer. Know when to stop and you will be free from danger. Thus you may endure.
transliteration: Zhī zú bù rǔ, zhī zhǐ bù dài, kě yǐ cháng jiǔ.
